scope: FIRST independent introduction saved-pixel review of exactly four authorized screenshots, one batch. Desktop 1440x960 and mobile 390x844 headless native-HTML views. Not a repeat science, source, Chinese, figure or browser/native review.
bindingMethod: Read and hash the display report once. Verify all four saved screenshot byte counts and SHA-256 values in one read-only command before the first view_image call. Open each screenshot once in the recorded order. Do not regenerate, crop, reset or reopen.

nativeHtmlBindingsFromVerifiedReport.provenance: Declared by the verified display report; not a new HTML/native revalidation.

perImageFindings.finding: Desktop whole: title and chapter/printed-page crumb are visible; all seven paragraphs flow in a restrained centered column. The analogy qualifications and final applications remain visible. Exercises 0 navigation is legible and separate from the prose. No visible horizontal clipping, overlap or missing page end.

Desktop supplied focus: the model/conditions qualification is readable and complete, including can obey. Earlier paragraphs and divider remain well separated. The scroll-frame top cuts through an earlier line, but whole-page evidence shows that this is viewport framing, not a page-layout defect. This focus does not show the final paragraph/navigation.

Mobile whole: title/crumb, seven paragraphs, section rules, both analogy paragraphs, final applications and Exercises 0 navigation are visible. Line wrapping keeps long terms inside the narrow page. No visible occlusion, horizontal clipping or overlap. This tall preview is not an all-glyph inspection.

Mobile supplied focus: the pendulum/LC example, corresponding-models/appropriate-conditions sentence, time-pattern explanation and nonidentity sentence are readable. The wave paragraph begins at the bottom and continues beyond the viewport; its full conditional wording is visible in the whole image. No manual crop or reopen was used.

visibleAcceptance.bodyFlow: Seven prose paragraphs and two section dividers are visibly ordered and separated on desktop and mobile.
visibleAcceptance.analogyCaveat: The model/conditions caveat is visibly readable in both supplied focus views; quantity and wave qualifications are present in the whole views.
visibleAcceptance.finalProseAndNavigation: The complete final applications paragraph and Exercises 0 navigation are visible and legible in both whole previews.
visibleAcceptance.viewportEdges: Ordinary scroll-window boundaries are not treated as clipping of the document. Whole images provide complete-page evidence.

existingDomEvidenceReused.provenance: Verified display report assertions, not rerun by this reviewer.
